title: Rounding consistency across export and report formats
gherkin:
Feature: Financial Report Accuracy - Rounding Consistency

  Scenario: Exported financial report applies consistent rounding rules
    Given a financial report with line items containing decimal values
    When the report is exported to multiple formats (PDF, CSV, JSON)

    And rounding discrepancies between formats must not exceed zero
    And the rounding method (round-half-up, banker's rounding, etc.) must be documented and consistent
rationale: The operative context identifies export/report rounding discrepancy as a primary concern. This test validates that rounding behavior is consistent across all export formats, preventing data integrity issues when financial reports are consumed in different systems.
